scripts.build: sh -c 'export DATABASE_URL="${DATABASE_URL:-${POSTGRES_PRISMA_URL:-${POSTGRES_URL_NON_POOLING:-$POSTGRES_URL}}}"; export DIRECT_URL="${DIRECT_URL:-${POSTGRES_URL_NON_POOLING:-$POSTGRES_URL}}"; prisma generate && if [ -n "$DATABASE_URL" ]; then prisma migrate deploy; else echo "Sem URL de banco configurada; pulando migrate deploy."; fi && node -e "console.log(\"Projeto Node/Express pronto para deploy.\")"'
